description: Change a form's name, status, questions, notifications, forwarding, close date, response limit, thank-you message or quiz scoring. Only the fields you pass change; fields replaces the whole question list. Set status to archived to stop taking responses. After setting destinations.webhookUrl, call replo_forms_webhook_secret_rotate to get the signing secret. For multi-step Replo work, call skills with name "replo".

FormFieldCondition.description: Ask only after a matching answer; otherwise skipped and not required

anyOf.description: Answers that show this question; true/false for checkboxes, digits for numbers, any pick for multi-select

fieldKey.description: The earlier question this depends on

FormFieldKey.description: The field's key in its form

closesAt.description: When the form stops taking responses; null never closes

destinations.description: Replaces the forwarding settings; the webhook signing secret is kept. After setting webhookUrl, call replo_forms_webhook_secret_rotate to get the signing secret

receiptEmail.description: Email each person who submits a receipt that their response arrived; off unless true. Booking forms always email their confirmation.

fields.description: Replaces every question; the site shows the change at once

scale.description: The answer is a whole number from 1 to this

multiple.description: Lets the visitor pick several; the answer is then a list

optionImageUrls.description: A picture to show on each choice, keyed by option text

additionalProperties.description: Stable identifier of the result, such as dry-skin

optionOutcomes.description: The result each choice counts toward in an outcomes quiz, keyed by option text

optionPoints.description: Points each choice adds to the score of a points quiz, keyed by option text; may be negative

marketingOptIn.description: Checking this box subscribes the person to the brand's marketing email

oneOf.description: Never shown; filled from a link parameter with the field's key, or from code
Starts a new step; every question up to the next section is one step. Never answered

routing.description: Book a different event type depending on an earlier answer

bookableKeys.description: The event type to book for each choice; a choice not listed books the field's own bookableKey

notifyEmails.description: People on the project who get an email for each new response; each must already be on the project

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

responseLimit.description: How many responses the form takes; null has no limit

anyOf.description: Turns the form into a quiz: each response gets a result the site shows on its own result screen

kind.description: points: choices add points and the score picks the result by range; outcomes: each choice counts toward a result and the most-picked wins, ties going to the earlier result

items.description: One result a visitor can get, such as Dry skin

key.description: Stable identifier of the result, such as dry-skin

maxScore.description: Points quizzes: the highest score for this result; no ceiling if left out

minScore.description: Points quizzes: the lowest score for this result; no floor if left out

scoring.description: Turns the form into a quiz; give choices optionPoints or optionOutcomes, and the site shows a screen per result. null turns scoring off

successMessage.description: The thank-you message; {field_key} is replaced with that answer, null uses the site's own

uniqueFieldKeys.description: Fields that identify a repeat entry, such as email; a repeat returns the first entry and sends nothing

name: replo_forms_update
title: Update a form
